items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Gene never worked for me until late in -- the late '40s

ctx.x: Yes. So that could have been earlier, although I recall distinctly that Gene Roland Rowland was playing trumpet in the band that we made these things for, and I didn't know Gene, Gene never worked for me until late in -- the late '40s. So it's -- but now with Will Cowan, those were all done at Universal, and it was an entirely different thing.

Well, at one point, after we've gone through the chronological thing I want to go through and read off -- because these are not, unfortunately, chronological. These are alphabetical in order, and so we'll go through and --
